findings.evidence_gap: The two prose descriptions of the mirror (under-invalidation) case diverge from the machine witness AND from each other. GEOMETRY_HOSTILES_V1.md says 'edge set {S->B}, d(S,A)=3: every ball radius r<3 misses affected B' - but with only edge S->B, B is the affected node at d(S,B)=2, which no ball of radius >=2 misses; naming d(S,A)=3 is irrelevant. R4_CONE_VS_BALL_G14_AT06.md says 'add edge S->B and remove S->A ... misses the affected node A' - with S->A removed, A is not affected at all. The actual witness (checker C4, hostile_cone_ball.json, atom row 'under_invalidate A') is correct and coherent: BOTH edges kept, d(S,A) stretched to 3, r=2, ball={B}, A affected-and-missed. Verdict is unaffected (it cites the witness), but a reader reconciling the prose would construct a non-working example.
findings.fix_hint: Rewrite both mirror-case sentences to the witness construction: keep S->A and S->B, set d(S,A)=3>r, r=2; ball={B} misses affected A.
